notes.title: Update 4,0 Ready!!!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10773841/0bef48a28a2d1216efd63b7ab6406abe6b144b8d.jpg[/img]

Tks to all of you for the wait.

See the comparation with V3,0 here: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vjmCvcBMMS4&feature=youtu.be


This update include:

New enemies
New blood interactions and mechanics.
New stage interactions and mechanics.
Alternative endings (good and bad ending).
New game mode (survival).
New menu interfaces and settings (sound, axis sensibility).
New story docs.
New achievements.
New enemy particle fxs.
New enemy animations.
New stage scares.
New sound fxs.


New languages supported (french, german, italian, russian).
Mac and linux version now availables.


Remade illumination and light bake in all stages.
Atmospheric particles.
Bloom.
Light glow.
Camera dirt
GI.
Motion blur.
Depth of field. 


Optimized Frame Rate.
Achievements fixed.
IA bugs fixed.
Collision bugs fixed.
Water level frame drop fixed.
Water interaction fixed.
Water color and material fixed.
Added textures and models.
Fixed materials.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10773841/02bf9cee0033c367c721a597b964332a2e5d0b62.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10773841/fdd3114631f913df8f29e452a9114be6928a1a2f.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10773841/e27641c710e3d36113687d30a26eadfbd0684053.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10773841/b0af378a6c922e32d9435fbec3b9437aab36d85b.jpg[/img]

In the next weeks we will be adding new content according to the feedback of the community. Also all the achievements that you get and we activate latter will be unlocked (example : if you now manage to get 30minutes in the survival  wink, wink ːsteammockingː, you will get that achievements as soon as is available) so don't worry about that. 

If you happened to find any bugs or have suggestions to improve the gameplay please comment here , so we can take it into account in  the next update.

notes.title: Update 04/01/2016 Version 2.0
notes.content:
Update 04/01/2016

Mayor bug Fixes (specially in enemy IA)

Collision with walls and furniture error that caused stage jump was eliminated

New textures for water levels

New textures for enemies

Texture quality improved

New Dead and Attack animations for the enemies

Annoying videos removed from the floors (only left when necessary)

New Chromos and Wallpapers

Story Videos edited to cut errors

Main menu and HUD minor changes

Total compatibility with joystick

Minor lightning bugs eliminated

2 new modes announced
